Prisoners: Murat comes home to Paris under this peace. Prisoners: Massena comes home to Paris under this peace. Prisoners: Deroy comes home to Paris under this peace.

Sire — 3 turns now with the establishment under the ordinance and the depots standing full. The ordinance allows 32,740 more; 10,000 foot cost 150 gold at Paris under Soult — 'recruit infantry in Paris'.
